arrivals.desc: Patients arriving at the ED this hour (excludes diverted)

first_seen.desc: Patients with first provider contact this hour

door_to_provider_sum_min.desc: Sum of arrival-to-first-provider minutes over patients first seen this hour (divide by first_seen for the mean)

wait_mean_min.desc: Mean arrival-to-first-provider time of patients first seen this hour; 0 when none

wait_p95_min.desc: 95th percentile arrival-to-first-provider time, trailing 24 h (histogram estimate, 5-minute bins)

lwbs.desc: Left without being seen this hour

lwbs_rate.desc: LWBS as a share of arrivals

diverted.desc: Ambulance arrivals turned away while on diversion

diversion_hours.desc: Fraction of this hour spent on ambulance diversion

ed_census.desc: Patients in the ED at the end of the hour (all pre-ward states)

waiting_count.desc: Patients not yet seen by a provider (waiting_triage..waiting_provider)

ed_departures.desc: Patients leaving the ED this hour (discharged, admitted to a ward bed, transferred, died)

ed_los_sum_min.desc: Sum of ED length of stay over ed_departures

boarding_count.desc: Admitted patients holding in ED bays

bay_occupancy.desc: Occupied treatment spaces / staffed treatment spaces

ward_occupancy.desc: Occupied / staffed inpatient beds available to ED admissions

admissions.desc: ED patients given an admit decision this hour

treated.desc: Patients exiting as discharged_ed, discharged_ward or transferred

deteriorations.desc: Patients whose acuity worsened while waiting

deaths.desc: Deaths (simulated; hazard is assumed/literature, see catalog)

adverse_events.desc: Deteriorations + deaths + error events attributable to fatigue/overload

overtime_hours.desc: Called-in and held-over staff hours paid at overtime rate

fatigue_mean.desc: Mean fatigue index of on-shift staff

revenue.desc: Revenue booked for patients completing care this hour

cost_labor.desc: Wages, overtime and agency premium this hour

cost_fixed.desc: Fixed cost of staffed spaces and equipment this hour

cost_variable.desc: Supplies and per-test costs this hour

cost_structural.desc: One-off build / relocation / purchase cost booked this hour

episode_summary.wait_p95_min: p95 over all patients first seen

wait.scale_note: patient-minutes waited this hour (all not-yet-seen patients accrue), / baseline

staff.scale_note: per overtime hour, plus fatigue above threshold

revenue.scale_note: negative cost: rewards revenue (so cost+revenue weights give margin)
